tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Run a FREE, count-only LaunchTrust quick scan on a public web URL. It runs a quick subset of LaunchTrust's compliance and security checks (frontend secrets, exposed .env/.git files, security headers, HTTPS/HSTS, privacy and terms pages, trackers and cookie consent, AI-interaction disclosure) and returns how many gaps it found, not which ones. The result is unsigned; the count is cached for 15 minutes and not otherwise stored. Which gaps they are, the evidence and how to close them come with LaunchTrust Monitoring (every detector, signed and dated records) or a one-time Launch Audit. Compliance aid, not legal advice.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to scan, e.g. https://example.com

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: List the jurisdictions and categories LaunchTrust tracks (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR, US state privacy laws, app-store policies). Public coverage registry. Compliance aid, not legal advice.

tools.name: get_compliance_rules
tools.description: Fetch LaunchTrust's sourced, founder-reviewed compliance rule snapshots, optionally filtered to one jurisdiction code (e.g. eu-ai-act-50, gdpr, ca-sb243). Compliance aid, not legal advice.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction code to filter by, e.g. gdpr or eu-ai-act-50.

tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Independently verify the ECDSA (ES256) signature on a LaunchTrust signed scan/disclosure record against the published public key. Pass the record JSON (the downloaded record, or an object containing `canonical` and `signature`).

record.description: The LaunchTrust signed record JSON (or an object with `canonical` + `signature`).

tools.name: list_my_apps
tools.description: List the apps registered in your LaunchTrust account, with each one's latest scan status. Requires a LaunchTrust token.

tools.name: register_app
tools.description: Register a web URL in your LaunchTrust account so it can be fully scanned and monitored. Idempotent — if the URL is already registered, returns the existing app. Requires a LaunchTrust token and an active subscription.

url.description: Public https URL of the app to register.

tools.name: scan_app
tools.description: Run the full LaunchTrust scan on one of your registered apps and store a signed, dated evidence record. Requires a LaunchTrust token and an active subscription. Limited to 5 scans per app per day.

app_id.description: The id of a registered app (see list_my_apps or register_app).

tools.name: get_scan_history
tools.description: List recent scans (summary + findings) for one of your registered apps. Requires a LaunchTrust token.

app_id.description: The id of a registered app.

tools.name: get_market_report
tools.description: Get the latest scan for one of your registered apps, with each finding annotated by the jurisdictions and rules applicable to that app's target markets. Requires a LaunchTrust token.

app_id.description: The id of a registered app.
